assets.source/title/title.png: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: replacement subtitle plaque for a preschool Pokémon FireRed modification. Generate exactly one wide horizontal logo, aspect ratio 4:1, with genuinely transparent background outside the plaque. The whole plaque must fit comfortably inside canvas with equal thin transparent margin. A solid dark navy rounded rectangular plaque with a chunky warm orange border. Inside it, very large extra bold friendly rounded block capitals in sunshine yellow, two tightly spaced centred lines of equal letter height. Text verbatim: first line "LITTLE", second line "TRAINERS". Spell T R A I N E R S correctly. The word TRAINERS spans almost the entire plaque width. The word LITTLE is shorter and centred above. Text is straight, no perspective, no arch, no cursive, no diagonal. The lettering is extremely simple and broad enough to survive reduction to a 128 by 32 pixel GBA sprite. Fill the interior behind every letter and letter counter with solid navy so game background cannot show through. Flat colours only: navy #202440, yellow #FFDE5A, orange #E87820. No highlights, no gradients, no texture, no shadows, no characters, no additional words, no Pokemon wordmark, no symbols or decorative stars. This is a legible game subtitle, not a full title screen.
